description: The chart represents the distribution of subtasks in the MMRA benchmark. There are 11 slices in the pie chart, each representing a different subtask. The slices are labeled with distinct categories, including "NearSameEntity" (dark gray, approximately 6.34%), "ObservationAngle" (red, 12.28%), "SimilarMaterial" (light green, 10.33%), "SubEvent" (purple, 9.74%), "UsageSimilarity" (pink, 9.65%), "Enviromment" (brown, 8.77%), "Layout" (teal, 8.77%), "AppearanceSimilarity" (light blue, 8.77%), "SimilarEvent" (blue, 8.77%), "MentalitySimilarity" (orange, 8.67%), and "RelativePosition" (gray, 7.90%). The chart includes percentage labels next to each slice, and the slices are arranged in no particular order. A legend is not present in the chart.
